articles.summary: Living with schizophrenia and major depression, a mental health advocate on how a daily habit of reflection through Sonia became one part of a bigger recovery toolkit.
articles.title: Finding a Safe Place to Think

articles.summary: In a randomized controlled trial, how much people used Sonia didn’t predict how much better they felt. What did: whether the first week earned their trust.
articles.title: We’re Not Trying to Keep You in the App

articles.summary: We handed Sonia to outside academic researchers and asked them to test it properly: randomized, pre-registered, IRB-approved, independently analyzed. Here is what they found — and what the study cannot tell us.
articles.title: We Tested Sonia the Way We’d Want Any Wellness Tool Tested
